scenes.title: Read-only emotion steering
scenes.sub: Embedding space · token scoring · zero writes
scenes.en: Episode three: P3, Anchor Echo. The headline is simple: it never modifies the model. It reads the model's own embedding weights, completely read-only, and steers generation toward emotional anchors.
scenes.zh: 第三集：P3 锚点回响。标题就是一句话：它从不修改模型。它只读模型自己的嵌入权重，完全只读，然后把生成向情感锚点引导。

scenes.title: Six emotional directions
points: joy · sadness · fear · anger · disgust · surprise
scenes.en: The architecture defines six emotional anchors, joy, sadness, fear, anger, disgust and surprise. Each anchor is a centroid computed from the model's own embedding weights. And it is provably read-only: checksums and pointers stay identical after the run.
scenes.zh: 架构定义六个情感锚点：喜、悲、惧、怒、恶、惊。每个锚点由模型自身的嵌入权重计算质心得到。而且这是可证明的只读：运行前后校验和、指针完全不变。

scenes.title: Every token vs. every anchor
scenes.en: Here is the key trick. Every token in the vocabulary is scored against every anchor using cosine similarity, producing a dense score table. The table is only 3.6 megabytes, yet it covers the entire vocabulary. P1's random projection was 933 megabytes. P3 shrinks that to almost nothing.
scenes.zh: 关键技巧在这里。词表中每个 token 都用余弦相似度对每个锚点打分，得到一张稠密打分表。表只有 3.6MB，却覆盖整个词表。P1 的随机投影是 933MB，P3 把它压缩到几乎为零。

scenes.title: logits += β · tanh(S·v / T)
scenes.en: To steer, a target emotional vector v is chosen, and the score table is projected onto it. After a tanh activation and a temperature, the result is added to the logits as a bias. Tanh guarantees the injection is bounded, so it cannot explode.
scenes.zh: 引导方式是：选一个目标情感向量 v，把打分表投影到 v 上，经过 tanh 激活和温度调节后，作为偏置加到 logits 上。tanh 保证注入有界，不可能爆炸。

scenes.title: +200% human-likeness
scenes.en: The results are the strongest of the family so far. TuringBench human-likeness jumps from 0.23 to 0.70, a 200 percent increase. HeartBench improves 21.7 percent. With a persona prompt, blind judge wins rise 56 percent.
scenes.zh: 这是目前家族里最强的结果。TuringBench 人似度从 0.23 飙升到 0.70，提升 200%。HeartBench 提升 21.7%。加上人设提示后，盲评胜率提升 56%。

scenes.title: Three channels, stackable
scenes.en: P3 is also stackable. The mixed anchor fuses anchor, echo and tide on three orthogonal channels. On a local 7 billion judge, the full stack beats baseline by 55.6 percent, with two independent judges agreeing on direction.
scenes.zh: P3 还可以叠加。混合锚点把锚点、回响、潮汐放在三条正交通道上融合。本地 7B 裁判下，全开比基线提升 55.6%，两个独立裁判方向一致。

scenes.title: Degrades gracefully
scenes.en: Deployment is flexible. With local weights, it reads embeddings directly. On cloud APIs, it falls back to logprobs, with entropy difference under one percent. In the most locked-down mode, it degrades to pure prompt, zero internal access.
scenes.zh: 部署很灵活。有本地权重时直读嵌入；云端 API 时降级用 logprobs，熵差不到 1%；在封锁最严的模式下，退化为纯提示词，零内部访问。

scenes.title: Works on strangers too
scenes.en: It is not picky about models. On gemma 2B, never seen in the scan table, it still gains 28.5 percent through the conservative fallback. And for closed-source APIs, it degrades gracefully to logprobs only, with entropy difference under one percent.
scenes.zh: 它对模型不挑剔。在从未见过的 gemma-2b 上，通过保守兜底依然提升 28.5%。对闭源 API，它能优雅降级为只用 logprobs，熵差不到 1%。

scenes.title: Open source, with a license
scenes.en: License note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with additional terms. Free for research and study. Commercial use requires the author's license.
scenes.zh: 授权说明：CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 加附加条款。研究和学习免费。商业使用需要作者授权。

scenes.title: The anchor is open
scenes.en: The Anchor Echo repository is open source, with the full benchmark scripts and data. Next episode: P4, KV Resonance, which makes the model literally look at the emotion.
scenes.zh: 锚点回响仓库已开源，包含完整基准脚本和数据。下一集：P4 KV 情感共振，让模型真正“看向”情感。
